week.name: This Afternoon
week.detailed: Partly sunny. High near 57, with temperatures falling to around 53 in the afternoon. South southeast wind 1 to 5 mph.

week.name: Tuesday
week.short: Light Rain then Rain And Snow
week.detailed: Rain between 8am and 5pm, then rain and snow. Cloudy. High near 52, with temperatures falling to around 43 in the afternoon. South southwest wind 2 to 8 mph. Chance of precipitation is 100%. New snow accumulation of around one inch possible.

week.name: Wednesday
week.detailed: Mostly sunny, with a high near 42. South wind around 3 mph.

week.name: Thursday
week.detailed: Rain and snow before 8am, then rain and snow. Cloudy, with a high near 42. New rainfall amounts between a tenth and quarter of an inch possible.

week.name: Friday
week.detailed: Snow. Cloudy, with a high near 37. New snow accumulation of around one inch possible.

week.name: Saturday
week.detailed: Partly sunny, with a high near 37.
week.night_short: Mostly Cloudy then Slight Chance Light Snow

week.name: Sunday
week.detailed: A chance of snow. Mostly cloudy, with a high near 40. Little or no snow accumulation expected.

nws_alerts.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued November 16 at 1:41PM MST until November 18 at 11:00AM MST by NWS Salt Lake City UT
nws_alerts.description:
* WHAT...Snow expected. For the Wasatch Mountains, forecast snow
totals of 4 to 8 inches above 8000 feet with locally higher amounts
in excess of 12 inches for the Upper Cottonwoods. For the Wasatch
Back, 1 to 4 inches with the highest amounts for Park City and the
Ogden valley.

* WHERE...The Wasatch Mountains, and Wasatch Back.

* WHEN...From 11 AM Tuesday to 11 AM MST Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be difficult at times along mountain routes.
The hazardous conditions will impact the Tuesday evening and
Wednesday morning commutes on higher passes such as Parleys Summit.

* ADDITIONAL…

nws_alerts.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued November 16 at 11:07AM MST until November 18 at 5:00AM MST by NWS Pocatello ID
nws_alerts.description:
* WHAT...Snow expected. Total snow accumulations between 4 and 8
inches with locally higher amounts at or above 8000 feet.

* WHERE...Bear River Range.  This includes Emigration Summit.

* WHEN...From 11 AM Tuesday to 5 AM MST Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Plan on slippery road conditions.

discussion.key_messages: - Widespread valley rain/snow and mountain snow Tuesday and Tuesday night. - Another longer last widespread valley rain/snow and mountain snow event for Thursday/Friday. - Freezing temperatures are increasing in probability for lower Washington County and the Virgin River corridor near Zion National Park Saturday and Sunday morning

rules_take: Beaver Mountain: the forecasts put 10–27 in. over the next 7 days (middle 13 in.), and they disagree a lot. About 6 in. of that lands in the next 72 hours. The NWS forecasters have 16 in. for the week.
